diff --git a/quantfusion/engine/signals.py b/quantfusion/engine/signals.py
index 3849153..869a922 100644
--- a/quantfusion/engine/signals.py
+++ b/quantfusion/engine/signals.py
@@ -87,6 +87,37 @@ class CoreSignalMixin:
             filtered.append(item)
         return filtered
 
+    def _fresh_native_cycle_reentry(self, signal: Signal, date_str: str) -> bool:
+        """Recognize a new native proposal after an actually closed trend cycle.
+
+        A risk-reduced cycle is not ordinary trend re-entry. This classification
+        neither restores historical quantities nor grants cash or risk capacity.
+        """
+        if (signal.strategy_name != "turtle_breakout"
+                or signal.signal_date != date_str
+                or not signal.reason.startswith("Turtle breakout(")):
+            return False
+        shares, risk_reduced, eligible = 0, False, False
+        for trade in self.trades:
+            if (trade.symbol != signal.symbol
+                    or trade.strategy_name.split(":")[-1] != signal.strategy_name
+                    or trade.date > date_str):
+                continue
+            if trade.direction == "buy":
+                if shares == 0:
+                    risk_reduced = False
+                shares += trade.shares
+                eligible = False
+            elif trade.direction == "sell":
+                shares -= trade.shares
+                if shares < 0:
+                    return False
+                ordinary_exit = trade.reason.startswith("Donchian exit")
+                risk_reduced = risk_reduced or not ordinary_exit
+                if shares == 0:
+                    eligible = ordinary_exit and not risk_reduced
+        return shares == 0 and eligible
+
